verification.validation: Focused release gate: ts vitest (entry hand-off, launchRoute and sign-in URL security cases), build and typecheck; Node build and packed consumer checks; docs, version and executor manifest checks; both npm archives scanned for internal content and secrets. Sign-in launchParam behaviour observed by hand on a DSM 7.3.2 controller (alias sign-in and DSM App start). No full gate, QEMU, executor rebuild, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: A signed-out visitor who opens an entry page link lands on the App's route after DSM's sign-in. The Portal alias sign-in URL carries the launch as DSM's launchParam (the window DSM opens after sign-in reads only that) and keeps ?link=; DSM's App start also carries a hash route as route.
Sign-in URLs stay on the entry's origin at a fixed path, drop a route, link or hash that launchRoute refuses, and never carry values named like a session or secret.
launchRoute refuses a route that leaves the App once percent-decoded (/%2F…, /%5C…, /%252F…); encoded characters later in a route stay valid.
Reuse executor 0.53.6 unchanged: executor sources and build inputs are unchanged.
